main.summary: Reconciles catalog pending-delete items and processes unfinished, token-scoped deletion jobs.

field.name: jobs
field.summary: Loads and persists unfinished deletion jobs, their progress, and retry state.

field.name: dataConfigs
field.summary: Enumerates configured catalogs and resolves each catalog's recovery storage.

field.name: grains
field.summary: Creates catalog grain references for pending-delete reconciliation.

field.name: options
field.summary: Controls leader retry and scan polling intervals, startup and cycle jitter, candidate paging, and bounded retry backoff.

field.name: processor
field.summary: Delegates each due job to the shared processor, which acquires the cross-process item lock.

field.name: leaderLock
field.summary: Provides named PostgreSQL advisory-lock leadership for deletion reconciliation and job processing.

constructor.name: DeletionAgent
constructor.summary: Initializes the deletion agent with catalog reconciliation, a deletion processor, and its polling and retry policy.
constructor.param: Orleans client factory for catalog grains.

method.name: ExecuteAsync
method.summary: Applies startup jitter, acquires named PostgreSQL leadership, retries followers at the configured leader retry interval, and retains leadership across polling and cycle-jitter delays until shutdown.
method.param: Signals that the hosted service should stop.

method.name: ProcessDueJobsAsync
method.summary: Verifies leadership while enumerating configured catalogs, reconciling paged pending-delete items into jobs, and processing due jobs.

method.name: ProcessJobAsync
method.summary: Delegates a due candidate to the durable deletion processor.

method.name: GetRandomDelay
method.summary: Returns a uniformly selected delay between zero and the supplied maximum.
